svg.title: Figure 3-SG-02-2. SG-02: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-02-2. SG-02: 27 events (backed 24, by design 1, external 3, unbacked 1); 36 FMEA modes reach SG-02 (in the tree 35, justified 1, tree gaps 0). BE-2.04 (Non-finite command clamped to 0 without a fault (controlsd.py:140-147, GAP-19)) → SWF-045: A non-finite input latches the controller state and silently zeroes lateral (or longitudinal) output while engaged; worst cause SWF-045.C1 (A NaN desired curvature (modelV2 or lateralManeuverPlan) or roll. At BL-004 it latched self.desired_curvature and the PID integrator for the drive (reproduced with the BL-004 clip_curvature and PIDController in isolation, scratch probe). Since #51 (BL-005) the step runs with latActive false, the controller is reset and desired_curvature is reset if non-finite (controlsd.py:122-128, 141-142, 155-156), so the latch is gone. Remaining: a persistent non-finite input silently zeroes lateral output while the item shows engaged, with no event or alert (TSR-604 asks an immediate disable; IA host-supervision OI-4); other inputs (vEgo, curvature from carState, vehicleParameters) are not guarded; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: controlsd and card are excluded from the process fuzz test because NaN/inf break them (test_fuzzy.py:10-13); no NaN injection test BE-2.11 (Non-finite command logged only (GAP-19)) → SWF-045: A non-finite input latches the controller state and silently zeroes lateral (or longitudinal) output while engaged; worst cause SWF-045.C1 (A NaN desired curvature (modelV2 or lateralManeuverPlan) or roll. At BL-004 it latched self.desired_curvature and the PID integrator for the drive (reproduced with the BL-004 clip_curvature and PIDController in isolation, scratch probe). Since #51 (BL-005) the step runs with latActive false, the controller is reset and desired_curvature is reset if non-finite (controlsd.py:122-128, 141-142, 155-156), so the latch is gone. Remaining: a persistent non-finite input silently zeroes lateral output while the item shows engaged, with no event or alert (TSR-604 asks an immediate disable; IA host-supervision OI-4); other inputs (vEgo, curvature from carState, vehicleParameters) are not guarded; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: controlsd and card are excluded from the process fuzz test because NaN/inf break them (test_fuzzy.py:10-13); no NaN injection test BE-2.05 (SoC crash or hang (whole SoC)) → SFM-005: Loss of lateral control without driver alert; worst cause SFM-005.C3 (Process crash or hang not detected by liveness checks; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.21 (selfdrived crash or hang: controlsd stops within ≈ 0.1 s, card keeps sending frames without torque (no arrival revocation); ui/soundd show "System Unresponsive" only after 5 s; pandad keeps the heartbeat (engaged = 0), so no heartbeat-loss siren (SFM-006.C1); since panda f4803c5 the engaged-mismatch check revokes at 0.39-0.48 s and the siren sounds at 0.63-0.88 s (TSR-307(a), TSR-516(c))) → SWF-036: selfdrived stops publishing selfdriveState (crash or hang) while engaged; worst cause SWF-036.C2 (Hang or starvation of the Python process (blocking Params writes in the 100 Hz loop, selfdrived.py:225, 311, 473; GIL contention with params_thread; CPU load); no process watchdog for selfdrived (process_config.py:97); O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-2.06 (Actuation frames stop reaching the bus: SoC configuration command (0xe5, 0xde, 0xf1; FFI-CM-09), MCU hang (SFM-033.C4), car-side bus-off (SFM-033.C5)) → DFM-008, DFM-021, DFM-004, DFM-016, DFM-018, DFM-012, PFM-008, PFM-006, SWF-024, SWF-047, SFM-005, SFM-011: Car-side transceiver holds the bus dominant; worst cause SWF-047.C1 (controlsd raises on input it does not guard and exits; the 100 Hz loop has no exception handling. The example of BL-004, int(NaN) when lateralDelay is not finite (latcontrol_torque.py:100), is guarded since #51 (falls back to steerActuatorDelay, controlsd.py:158-160); other inputs are not; O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No test injects non-finite lateralDelay BE-2.17 (Loss of the actuation frames not reported in time by the SoC: no check that the frames reach the bus; seen only indirectly (pandaStates, canError) with timing not analysed (to confirm, OI-10)) → SWF-020, SWF-024, SWF-060: Heartbeat reports engaged while no fresh command reaches the panda; worst cause SWF-020.C1 (engaged is derived only from selfdriveState alive (<0.1 s), valid and enabled (pandad.cc:424). Neither carControl/sendcan freshness nor the forwarding thread's progress goes into the heartbeat, which is sent from the main thread (pandad.cc:313), so the heartbeat shows pandad and selfdrived liveness only (host side of SWF-014.C2; TSR-409 / TSR-602 not implemented); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause BE-2.07 (Loss of the 12 V supply to the device (FSC node N08)) → DFM-012, DFM-020, PFM-008: Harness disconnected or intermittent while driving; worst cause DFM-012.C1 (Connector not fully latched at installation, or vibration loosens it; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) UE-2.18 (Driver does not notice the end of LKA torque or the cluster cruise indicator (AOU-01R, AOU-12)): No FMEA row needed: external; AOU-01R, AOU-12 BE-2.23 (Achieved curvature below the desired: envelope torque limit below what the curve needs, or controller or torque model too weak (SFM-004.C1, C3; ODD curve bound, WP-C-03 OI-7)) → SFM-004: Insufficient lateral control (undershoot in curves, drift toward lane edge); worst cause SFM-004.C1 (Safety model torque limit below what the curve requires (by design); O 6, D 10, AP H); detection: No pre-release test targets this cause BE-2.24 (steerSaturated needs a saturated controller and > 1.2x undershoot; its timing is not analysed against the 1 s budget (SFM-ACT-017)) → SFM-038: Warning of a lateral-control fault or limit late, not escalated or missing; worst cause SFM-038.C2 (pandad publishes the panda fields epsFault and requestsRejected (pandad.cc:137-138), but no SoC process reads them (txRateExceeded is read, TSR-615), so a panda-side EPS-fault refusal reaches the driver only through the panda siren and the stock EPS path (SW FMEA SWF-025 notes); O 8, D 10, AP H); detection: No test targets this cause

Worst cause: highest AP, then highest D. Red: single-point path from the gate logic. Text cut with … is given in full in the figure description.
